Card Q&A.a: That's correct. This card has a "Name: Also treated as [X Antibody]" rule, therefore a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards isn't treated as "1 of your Digimon without [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards."
Card Q&A.q: If a Digimon has this card in its digivolution cards, does that mean that it isn't treated as "1 of your Digimon without [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards"?

Card Q&A.a: No, it activates even if only this card is in the digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's inherited effect only activate if both [X Antibody] and a Digimon card are in the digivolution cards?

If a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards would be deleted other than by one of my effects, then an effect such as  prevents it from being deleted, does this card's inherited effect activate?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If digivolution isn't performed using this card's effect, you can't place this card in digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card and then place this card in digivolution cards without digivolving 1 of my Digimon without [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards?

Effect: While you have a Digimon, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] Add this card to the hand.

[Main] 1 of your Digimon without [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [X Antibody] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1. If this effect digivolved, place this card as its bottom digivolution card.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, from its digivolution cards, return 1 Digimon card to the hand and place 1 [X Antibody] as your top security card.
